items.question: To which deity are the seed-syllables gaṃ and gāṃ directed in obeisance?
premises: The syllables gaṃ and gāṃ function as mantric seed-syllables in the formula.
The compound vahni-gehinī identifies the wife of fire, Svāhā, as the recipient.
items.inference: The formula offers obeisance with the seed-syllables gaṃ and gāṃ to Svāhā, the wife of fire.
uncertainties: The precise ritual function of the two seed-syllables in this specific Śrīvidyā context is not explicit in the verse alone.
items.plain_english: Obeisance, with the seed-syllables gaṃ and gāṃ, to the wife of fire.
